answer: In this PoA design, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to accumulate durable weight. EigenTrust factorization, reciprocity-weighted transitivity, and temporal attenuation leave a freshly spawned Sybil with near-zero eigenvector centrality; it therefore cannot influence or pass consensus. Even aliases named quill, tundra, or onyx gain no standing without verified interaction history.
